checks.observed: Obtains derived Ready at exact located call, extracts certified same-call subtree and interval bound, aligns r with actual Request.eval via ThetaAt.sound_inner, then applies atomic_call to exact same result. Returns local post-journal at budget+chronological-before+inner.count and all three local observations. Does not substitute a separately evaluated call.
checks.budget: before false-child adds zero local prefix; true-tail adds child.count and marker; transparent wrappers preserve prefix. call_interval gives before+inner.count<=whole.count, so whole execution bound implies local starting budget bound. Work in reverted descendants remains counted, conservatively.
